sn12.65:1.2: tatra kho bhagavā … pubbeva me bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
sn12.65:1.3: kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jiyyati ca miyyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca
sn12.65:1.4: atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa
sn12.65:1.5: kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyi ssati jarāmaraṇassāti.
sn12.65:1.7: kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇanti.
sn12.65:1.8: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:1.9: jātiyā kho sati jarā maraṇaṃ hoti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti.
sn12.65:2.2: kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti …pe…
sn12.65:2.11: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:2.12: viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti.
sn12.65:2.14: kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā viññāṇanti.
sn12.65:2.15: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:2.16: nāmarūpe kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇanti.
sn12.65:3.2: paccudāvattati kho idaṃ viññāṇaṃ nāmarūpamhā na paraṃ gacchati
sn12.65:3.3: ettāvatā jāyetha vā jiyyetha vā miyyetha vā cavetha vā upapajjetha vā yadidaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā viññāṇaṃ
sn12.65:3.8: samudayo samudayoti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn12.65:4.2: kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:4.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:4.5: jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:4.8: kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti …pe…
sn12.65:4.17: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:4.18: viññāṇe kho asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:5.2: kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:5.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.65:5.5: nāmarūpe kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti
sn12.65:6.2: adhigato kho myāyaṃ maggo bodhāya yadidaṃ
sn12.65:6.7: avametassa kevalassa dukkhak khandhassa nirodho hoti.
sn12.65:6.8: nirodho nirodhoti kho me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
sn12.65:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso araññe pavane caramāno passeyya purāṇamaggaṃ purāṇañjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ.
sn12.65:7.3: tamanugacchanto passeyya purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvutthaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
sn12.65:7.4: atha kho so bhikkhave puriso rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā āroceyya
sn12.65:7.5: yagghe bhante jāneyyāsi ahaṃ addasaṃ araññe pavane caramāno purāṇamaggaṃ purāṇañjasaṃ pubbakehi manussehi anuyātaṃ so tamanugacchiṃ
sn12.65:7.6: tamanu gacchanto addasaṃ purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvutthaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇisampannaṃ uddā pavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ
sn12.65:7.8: atha kho so bhikkhave rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā taṃ nagaraṃ māpeyya
sn12.65:7.9: tadassa nagaraṃ aparena samayena iddhaṃ ceva phītaṃ ca bahujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ vuḍḍhivepullappattaṃ.
sn12.65:7.10: evameva khvāhaṃ bhikkhave addasaṃ purāṇamaggaṃ purāṇañjasaṃ pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyātaṃ.
sn12.65:8.1: katamo ca so bhikkhave purāṇamaggo purāṇañjaso pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyāto.
sn12.65:8.4: ayaṃ kho so bhikkhave purāṇamaggo purāṇañjaso pubbakehi sammāsambuddhehi anuyāto so tamanugacchiṃ
sn12.65:8.24: tada bhiññāya ācikkhiṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
sn12.65:8.25: tayidaṃda bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ iddhaṃ ceva phītaṃ ca vitthārikaṃ bahujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi supakāsitanti.
